## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `26f9502d42d6fe595c168e6bb5bbdbbdf8894713`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/area-lease.md + none
Security-touching: yes
Rule-change-verified: ruled

PR #36209, card #35792. Inputs read: the card body and its four comments (triage 7034174536, unblock 7053556584, claim 7070466545, os-dev-report 7070700392), the PR body, the one-file net diff (+2 -5), the check-runs on the head, and ruling record 7033659866 on #35784. Live tree read at `origin/main` 1d060265; the head is 1 ahead and 4 behind it, the file list against it is still the one file, and the target line on live main is byte-identical to the diff's minus side.

On `Security-touching: yes`: the one meaning hunk decides which security cards leave an area for the seat session and names disclosure discipline as the test, so it teaches disclosure-handling behaviour. The path is under `.claude/**`, not `skills/**` or `ui/skills/**`, so this line asks for no `security` label; it only keeps the low-risk skills arm off this PR, which lands on the rule-change line instead.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept-set change, one: the area hand-out closed set on the lane-keeping line goes from `他道在线席已认领、cloud 路由、安全、ADR` to `他道在线席已认领、cloud 路由、披露纪律卡、ADR`. Derived effect, right: a `security` card with no private detail is no longer handed out for its label and is routed by size like any other card; a card under disclosure discipline is still handed to the seat. Because the set is closed, nothing else in it moves.
- No public surface: no package, schema, script or gate in the diff. Right.
- The two other hunks (the same-series-card item and the two continuations of the lane-keeping item) join wrapped list continuations onto their first line. Compared word by word against the minus side: no word, punctuation mark or code span changed; only newline-plus-indent removed. Markdown list continuation renders the same. Right.
- Byte ratchet: the head blob is 6586 bytes, live main's is 6586, the ceiling in `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` is 6586 and is untouched by the diff. `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` and `Lint · repo & tooling gates` conclude success on the head. Right: no ceiling raise, as the card constrains and as the ruling record says it orders none.

### ② Semver level

Nothing is published: one governed skill reference under `.claude/**`. The PR carries `skip-changeset`; `Check Changeset` concludes success on the head. `Clause-②: no` on the PR body and on the claim is correct: no accept-set of a published schema or runtime narrows or widens.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: empty in the os-dev-report. Nothing to answer.
- Deviation, base moved (order named fa304140, work based on cbd582f4): answered. The line was re-read here on 1d060265 and is unchanged; GitHub reports the PR mergeable and clean.
- Deviation, model-free commit trailer: no contract effect; not a face of this review.
- Deviation, L2 record owed: this record.
- Card constraint, start only after #35740 merges: met, triage comment 7053556584 records the merge at 2026-11-20 23:34Z, before the claim.
- Card task, sweep the file for any other line that hands a card out for being `security` alone: re-done here on the live file. The not-in-area line (big cards, queue watch), the three pre-claim checks (big card), the card-order line (p0/p1 order only) and the seat-mailbox line (security findings follow `security-findings.md`, a findings path and not a card hand-out) carry no such rule. The sweep's result stands.
- SQL push-down: not applicable, no code in the diff.

### ④ Design judgment

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/area-lease.md`, against the ruling it copies and the spec it must agree with on `main`.

- Rule-change check. The lane-keeping hunk is the only hunk that alters what gets dispatched where; the two join hunks are wrapping only. The PR body's `Ruling-ref:` quote was compared with comment 7033659866 character for character: option 「只看大小,p1 只管先后」 and its consequence 「S 卡用子代理,M 卡有区进区,大卡才一卡一线程;有披露纪律的安全卡仍留座位。要立卡改技能这一行。」 match the record. The record also carries the maintainer's question, 「p1，安全卡只是优先级，不代表复杂度，为什么一定要不进区？」, which is this very line's subject: security cards barred from areas for the label alone. The hunk removes exactly that bar and keeps the seat for cards under disclosure discipline, which is the consequence sentence. The hunk copies the ruling; `ruled` is verified, matching the PR body's `Rule-change: ruled`.
- Agreement with `dispatch-runbook.md` on `main` (card-thread section): line 120 reads that p1 and `security` set order only, line 124 defines `披露纪律卡` as private detail that may not leave the seat session and keeps such a card in the seat. The new closed-set member is that defined term, so the two files now give one answer for both kinds of security card. `SKILL.md` line 69 says the same and defers to that section. The card's done-when holds.
- Break attempts. (a) A security card with private detail reaching an area: still handed out, by the new member. (b) A repo security advisory: never a queue card (`lanes/security.md`: no `pm:queue`, no file surface), so it never reaches an area's claim step under either wording. (c) Conflict with the not-in-area line or the pre-claim big-card hand-off: none, those test size and the closed set is tested separately. (d) Text pins: a search of the live tree for the closed-set phrase and the term finds only this line and runbook line 124; no script or test pins the old word.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

- N1 (nit) — `披露纪律卡` is used here bare, while its one definition lives in `dispatch-runbook.md` line 124; the neighbouring items cite their source file. The file is at headroom 0 and the area already reads that runbook before claiming (the pre-claim item three lines up), so the reader reaches the definition. Accepted deviation.
- N2 (nit) — the runbook term covers any card under disclosure discipline, where the ruling's sentence says security cards under it. Such a card already stays in the seat by runbook line 124 on `main`, so this hunk adds no rule beyond what is live; noted so the wording difference is on record. Accepted deviation.
- N3 (nit) — the old member was a label test and the new one is a content test: an area now decides from the card whether private detail is involved. That is the ruling's own consequence, not a defect of the copy; if areas misjudge it in practice, a follow-up card can add a mechanical mark. No change asked on this head.

- 用户无感:车队调度技能里,分区原先把所有安全卡一律交回席位,现在只交回带披露纪律的那一类,其余安全卡按大小照常分流。
- 为什么做:落实你在成本复盘线程里选的「只看大小,p1 只管先后」(裁决记录 7033659866),补上上一轮没改到的分区规则。
- 出错会怎样:只影响调度代理怎么分流卡片,不碰产品代码;最坏是一张普通安全卡在分区里做完,这一行可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。这是 Tier S,合同审查 PASS 后由席位入队。
- 席位意见:ACCEPT。改动只有一个词义变化,与 dispatch-runbook.md 卡线程段的定义一致,其余两处是折行合并。
